phase: Round 1 Phase 1 — baseline evaluation & internal grading harness

split.note: Climatology coefficients are estimated on train days only; validation windows use observed inputs for their 3-day history and score only the 10 target days.

config.latitude_weights: cos(deg2rad(lat)) normalised to mean 1 via monsoon_r1.contract.lat_weights
config.doy_convention: phase = 2*pi*doy/365 (monsoon_r1.contract.doy_sincos); future dates are real calendar dates

window_sampling.rule: init day every stride days per sampled month; the init day and all 10 target days lie inside the validation period (the 2-day history may reach into the last observed days of the train period, which are inputs only, never fitted values)

config.aggregation: RMSE/CSI/variance-ratio figures are arithmetic means over windows of the per-window kit metric (the judge averages per-window skill); pooled variants are also stored

notes: Predictions are cast to float32, the dtype of the /simulate wire format; all metrics are then the kit's own numpy implementations.
null values mean the metric is undefined for that slice (never silently zeroed).
Persistence ignores the calendar; climatology uses the real target date's day-of-year.
Climatology tp is floored at the configured value to satisfy the physical validity gate; the number of floored cells is reported per baseline.

overall.label: All sampled validation windows (Monsoon onset (June), Peak monsoon (July-August), Post-monsoon cyclone (October), Winter cold wave (January))
